verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs cover multiple standard OAuth2/OIDC flows in depth—client credentials (M2M), device authorization flow, and refresh/access token handling via Token Vault—clearly positioning Auth0 as a drop-in OAuth2/OIDC implementation rather than requiring hand-rolled protocol logic. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation calling out the authorization code flow with PKCE by name, so full breadth of the specific flows named in the story isn't directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit authorization-code-with-PKCE flow documentation, independent hands-on verification of refresh-token rotation behavior.
